Pico De Gallo Salsa
By: Steph Bauer
Published: Saturday, September 5, 2015 - 12:18pm

Ingredients




1 Onion, Chopped
10-12 Roma Tomatoes, Diced
1/2 Cup Cilantro, Chopped
1 Lime, Juiced
Salt to taste

Preparation

1 Dice onion and tomato and add to bowl, mix 2 Chop cilantro and mix into onion and tomato 3 Juice lime into the bowl on top of the vegetables and mix again 4 Add salt to taste, Enjoy!

About

One of my all time favorite snacks is Tostitos Tortilla Chips, Hint of Lime and my own Pico De Gallo. This recipe is perfect for snacking or wolfing down, or even putting on burritos!
